newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells $37 million of treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells $37 million of treasury bills.

text.p: The Bank of Mauritius sold 766.6 million rupees ($37 million) of treasury bills during its weekly auction out of a total 1.0 billion rupees put on tender, the central bank said on Thursday.

It said it sold 91.0 million rupees of 91-day, 437.0 million rupees of 182-day and 238.6 million rupees of 364-day bills with average weighted yields of 9.36 percent, 9.32 percent and 9.40 percent, respectively.
This week's effective bank rate was posted at 9.60 percent per annum from 9.56 percent last week, the bank said.
Last week, the bank sold 700 million rupees of 91-, 182- and 364-day treasury bills with weighted yields of 9.23 percent, 9.23 percent and 9.38 percent, respectively.
